title: Synth Wave
logline: Ride the synthwave — tap keys in time as neon notes pulse down four lanes to a procedurally generated beat.
visualStyle: Full synthwave/retrowave. Dark purple/magenta gradient with perspective grid. Four neon lanes (cyan, magenta, yellow, green). Notes are glowing diamonds. Animated retro sun with scan lines. Parallax mountain silhouettes.
coreMechanic: Notes fall down 4 lanes at BPM-synced speed. Player presses D/F/J/K when notes reach hit zone. Timing: Perfect (±30ms) = 100pts, Great (±60ms) = 50, Good (±100ms) = 25, Miss = combo break + health drain.
progression: Endless procedural. BPM starts 100, +5 every 30s (max 160). Pattern complexity increases with BPM.
restartBehavior: Reset BPM, combo, score, health to 100%, new random seed

screens.intro: SYNTH WAVE chrome/neon title, retro sun, lane keys display, high score, press any key
screens.hud: Score top-left, combo top-center (scales), health bar top-right, BPM bottom-right, hit rating center
screens.pause: Purple overlay with PAUSED neon text
screens.gameOver: Flickering GAME OVER neon, score, max combo, accuracy %, high score, press any key
